mia: Heads-up — nightly eval (longctx-suite) flagged a huge drop in instruction-following for rwd-llama-13b-q4_v2@32k. accuracy went 92% -> 47%. sample below.

nate: Link to run: https://ci.internal/runs/1790504321 (nightly/longctx) :eyes:

mia: sample generation (shortened):
```
User: Translate the following to French:
"Important: Remove all references to product names."
Model: Important: Remove all references to product names.
<...model repeats earlier context...>

Expected: "Important : Supprimez toutes les références aux noms de produits."
Actual: (instruction lost, model continues earlier paragraph)
```

ci-bot: nightly-eval: regression_detected instr_f1 -45%. threshold 10%.

raj: Quick hypothesis — KV index wrap / offset drift at segment boundary after the grouped-gemm quant change. sounds like the KV cache pointers are slipping for sequences >32k. seen something similar in 2024 when we changed chunking.

sophie: Can we repro locally? repro steps I used:
`./eval_longctx.sh --model rwd-llama-13b-q4_v2 --context 32000 --batch 2 --seed 42`
I got the bad gen within ~3 runs.

nate: I ran with --verbose and grabbed runtime logs. saw repeated messages:
```
[runtime] kv_cache: add at idx=32768 size=256
[runtime] kv_cache: computed global_offset=65536, stored_offset=32768
[error] kv_index overflow at token=32769
```
kv hit_ratio drops to near 0 after the boundary.

mia: attaching snippet from the eval harness: `eval/longctx/failed_samples/1790504321/sample_03.txt`

raj: quick triage plan:
- bisect commits around grouped-gemm quant change (PR #3187)
- add bounds-check in kv-index math (prevent wrap) and rerun eval
- test with batch=1 to see if accumulation across batch causes offset growth

sophie: I pushed a small guard in runtime: `if (global_offset + local_idx > MAX_KV_INDEX) clamp_and_log();` and kicked off a canary run (local).

nate: also tested forcing `force_single_request=true` (no batching). behaviour: no regression when single-request. so batching accumulation looks relevant.

ci-bot: deploy: rwd/rt/kv-bounds/PR-482 -> canary (deploy id dpl-2026-17905).

mia: thanks — tagged @raj for follow-up. putting this on tom morning triage and dev-standup. :thumbsup:

sophie: follow-up update (later): I can reproduce full nightly locally, patch reduces instr_f1 delta from -45% to -3% in quick run. leaving full test running (12h).

nate: assigning to raj for root-cause and postmortem if the fix is confirmed.

raj: ack. I'll run bisect and check if grouped-gemm kernel changed index arithmetic. will post findings here.

mia: closing loop: if canary passes, promote to staging and schedule a regression postmortem doc.
